card.name: Partway through drug and medical terms
card.fires_on: Mid-term pieces of long drug or medical names (abacavir, glucose-6-phosphate, immunodeficiency, simvastatin, ERBB2), plus some linking words like "after" or "in" in label text.

modes.label: Inside long names
modes.description: A piece in the middle or end of a drug, enzyme or virus name that is still being spelled out.

modes.label: Linking words in label sentences
modes.description: Short words such as after or in that sit before timing or population details.
modes.example: Patients should undergo their procedure 2-8 days<< after>> the last dose.

card.writes: Promotes odd foreign and name-like word pieces and suppresses words like first, second and end; no clear link to the text.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of long drug and disease names, and on a few small linking words in label text.
